build_ThetaModel: build a ThetaModel with embedding layer and MLP for multi-task RL theta sampling
create_ThetaSamplingStrategy: create a ThetaSamplingStrategy enum with embedding, zero, mean, and mean_train strategies
run_ThetaModel_forward: run the ThetaModel forward pass to sample theta values using a specified strategy
review_ThetaModel_compute_theta: review the ThetaModel _compute_theta_for_one_mode method to understand embedding, zero, mean, and mean_train sampling
test_ThetaModel_forward: test the ThetaModel forward method with train and base modes for theta sampling
